spots.line: Heavy carpets over the stone to keep the desert chill out after dusk.
Clay amphoras filled with rosewater and dates.

chests.line: A cedar merchant box under a divan, smelling of clove and resin.

people.name: a spice trader from the dunes
chatter: Lost three camels to the sun-scorch. The salt was worth more than the beasts.
Do not sleep without cloth across your mouth. The sand finds teeth.

people.name: Kamil of the Red Blade
chatter: Steel cools fast in the night. Keep it sheathed close to your ribs.
The road across the Great Dune is open only when the south wind dies.
